title: Automated Enterprise Code Transformation and Language Upgrades
oneLiner: Amazon Q Developer's transformation agent analyzes legacy repositories, plans dependency and syntax upgrades (such as Java 8/11 to Java 17), builds the project, and fixes compilation errors.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: Amazon Q Developer's transformation agent analyzes legacy repositories, plans dependency and syntax upgrades (such as Java 8/11 to Java 17), builds the project, and fixes compilation errors.
requirements: AWS Builder ID or IAM Identity Center
steps: Open project in IDE with Amazon Q
Review transformation diff and build verification report.
configSnippet: "/transform Upgrade this Maven repository from Java 11 to Java 17 and update incompatible Spring Boot dependencies."
limitations: Primary transformation workflows focus on supported enterprise stacks (.NET, Java, mainframe)
